identification: Short live-edge slab of pale golden timber, about 1.2 m long and 20-25 cm wide, catalogued Huon pine. Large knot and void near the top, checking along the face, bark loss on live edge. Photo cannot confirm species; Gowans has sold many similar 'Huon pine' slabs, mostly plain pale pieces that look more like celery top or similar. Timber is narrow and defective.

viewing_check: Confirm species: scent (sweet, oily Huon smell), fine tight grain, colour change on a fresh scrape. Check size and thickness, how deep the void and checks go, whether the slab is flat, and any end splits or insect damage. Photograph the end grain and the back.
